## PR #1250 — "First version of filters"

### 1. User-facing feature

Adds **interactive filters to nao Stories**. When an agent (or a user editing a story) declares one or more `<filter id="..." type="select|multi_select|search|date_range" .../>` tags in a story, a filter bar renders above the story content with the corresponding controls (dropdown, multi-select checklist, search box, date-range pickers). Selecting values re-runs the story's underlying SQL queries with the filter conditions applied, and charts/tables update in place (loading spinner overlay, x-axis categories preserved so bars/lines don't jump around, "no results match filters" empty state). Filter selections are persisted in the URL (`story_filter_<id>` query params) so filtered views are shareable/bookmarkable. This works across all three story surfaces: chat preview, standalone story, and publicly shared story links.

It also ships a secondary, related capability: **inline SQL editing**. The "expand" side-panel action on `execute_sql` results is replaced by an "edit" action that lets a user modify and re-run/save a query's SQL directly (Monaco editor, ⌘Enter to run, ⌘S to save), which then propagates back into the chat message history so downstream chart/table tags relying on that `query_id` reflect the edit.

The whole thing is gated behind a new `BETA_STORY_FILTERS_ENABLED` env flag (off by default, surfaced through `system.getPublicConfig`), so it's an opt-in beta.

### 2. Technical approach

- **SQL templating language** (`apps/shared/src/sql-template.ts`, new): filters are embedded directly in SQL via `{% filter id %} ... {{ filters.id.sql }} ... {% endfilter %}` blocks.
  - `stripSqlFilterBlocks` — removes filter blocks entirely; used for the default/baseline execution path (chat `execute_sql`, live/no-cache story refresh) so filter syntax never leaks into normal SQL execution.
  - `renderSqlTemplate` — given user selections + filter types, substitutes the block's placeholder with a properly quoted/escaped SQL fragment (`select`→ quoted string, `multi_select`→ `IN (...)`, `search`→ `LIKE '%...%'`, `date_range`→ `BETWEEN`-style pair) or drops the block if the filter is inactive.
  - Filter type registry (`STORY_FILTER_TYPES`) shared between validation, parsing, and rendering.
- **Story markup parsing** (`apps/shared/src/story-segments.ts`, `story-validation.ts`): a new `filter` segment type/tag, parsed alongside existing `chart`/`table`/`grid` tags, with its own required-attribute validation (self-closing, `id`+`type` required, must have `table+column` or hardcoded `options` for select types).
- **Backend service layer** (`apps/backend/src/services/story-filters.ts`, new): 
  - `getStoryFilterOptions` — loads dropdown options either from a hardcoded `options` attr or via a `SELECT DISTINCT column FROM table LIMIT 100` against the target database (identifiers validated via new `sql-identifiers.ts` guard against injection).
  - `getFilteredStoryQueryData` — re-executes all of a story's SQL queries through `renderSqlTemplate` with the active selections (or `stripSqlFilterBlocks` when no selections are active).
  - Exposed via new tRPC procedures on both `story.routes.ts` (owned) and `shared-story.routes.ts` (public share), each behind an `assertStoryFiltersEnabled` guard.
- **Agent tool integration** (`agents/tools/story.ts`, `agents/tools/execute-sql.ts`): tool descriptions teach the LLM the `<filter>` tag syntax and the SQL template block syntax when the beta flag is on. `execute_sql` also gained a `query_id` input allowing the agent to edit an existing query in place (new `apps/backend/src/queries/execute-sql.queries.ts` for looking up/updating the stored tool-call message part by `query_id`), which both the agentic filter-authoring flow and the new manual SQL-editor UI depend on.
- **SQL edit tRPC routes** (`apps/backend/src/trpc/sql.routes.ts`, `services/update-sql.ts`, new): `previewQuery`/`updateQuery` mutations for the side-panel SQL editor, with ownership checks (`getExecuteSqlOwnerByQueryId`) and reuse of the same `executeQuery` tool logic.
- **Frontend data flow**: `useStoryFilters` hook (new) parses filters out of the story code, manages selection state (synced to URL), debounces selections (300ms), and fetches filtered query data via tRPC (owned vs. shared API surface abstracted through a `StoryFilterApi` discriminated union). `StoryFilterBar` (new) renders the controls and per-filter option-loading errors (with a "fix in chat" shortcut). `StoryTabbedContent` wires the hook's output into `renderChart`/`renderTable` callbacks, replacing the old plain `queryData` prop with a richer `StoryEmbedRenderOptions` (queryData, baselineQueryData, hasActiveFilters, isRefreshing). `story-embeds.tsx` (`StoryChartEmbed`/`StoryTableEmbed`) now blends baseline and filtered results (`alignChartDataToBaselineX` in `charts.utils.ts` keeps chart x-axis categories stable, zero-filling filtered-out rows) and shows a refresh overlay.
- All three story route files (preview/standalone/shared) were updated in parallel to construct a `filterApi` and pass `baselineQueryData` through to `StoryTabbedContent`.

### 3. Areas of risk / complexity

- **SQL templating via regex/string substitution** rather than a real parser (`sql-template.ts`) — quoting/escaping is manual (`quoteSqlString`, `escapeLikePattern`); correctness across SQL dialects (BigQuery, Snowflake, Postgres, etc.) isn't dialect-aware.
- **Injection surface**: filter option loading builds raw SQL from user/agent-supplied `table`/`column` identifiers; mitigated by `assertSafeSqlIdentifier`, but this is a new, security-sensitive code path worth close scrutiny. Filter *values* go through `quoteSqlString`, not parameterized queries.
- **Duplicated logic across 3 route files**: preview/standalone/shared story routes each reimplement nearly identical `renderChart`/`renderTable`/filterApi wiring — a maintenance/consistency risk if one is updated and others aren't.
- **New query-editing surface** (`sql.routes.ts`, `update-sql.ts`) mutates persisted chat message parts (`updateExecuteSqlPart`) outside the normal agent tool-call flow — touches chat history integrity and interacts with `query_id` reuse logic in `execute-sql.ts`'s `updateExistingQuery`.
- **State synchronization complexity**: filter selections live in both React state and URL params, combined with debouncing, `keepPreviousData`, and baseline vs. filtered query data reconciliation (`alignChartDataToBaselineX`) — several moving parts that could desync (e.g., stale placeholder data, x-axis misalignment when columns are renamed).
- **Feature-flag-gated but broad blast radius**: even though gated by `BETA_STORY_FILTERS_ENABLED`, the changes touch shared/core files (`story-segments.ts`, `story-validation.ts`, `execute-sql.ts` tool, `live-story.ts`) used by the non-beta path too, so regressions could affect users with the flag off.
- **No visible test coverage for the new tRPC routes, `story-filters.ts` service, or `use-story-filters` hook** — tests were added mainly for the shared parsing/templating utilities (`sql-template.test.ts`, `story-segments.test.ts`, `story-filters.test.ts`), not for backend service/route logic or frontend behavior.

### 4. Most important files changed

| File | Role |
|---|---|
| `apps/shared/src/sql-template.ts` (new) | Core filter templating engine (parse/strip/render SQL filter blocks) |
| `apps/shared/src/story-segments.ts` | Adds `<filter>` tag parsing/segment type |
| `apps/shared/src/story-validation.ts` | Validation rules for `<filter>` tags |
| `apps/backend/src/services/story-filters.ts` (new) | Server-side filter option loading + filtered query execution |
| `apps/backend/src/utils/sql-identifiers.ts` (new) | Guards against unsafe SQL identifiers for filter option queries |
| `apps/backend/src/trpc/story.routes.ts` / `shared-story.routes.ts` | New `getFilterOptions`/`getFilteredQueryData` endpoints (owned + shared) |
| `apps/backend/src/services/update-sql.ts` + `apps/backend/src/trpc/sql.routes.ts` (new) | Backend for in-place SQL query editing |
| `apps/backend/src/queries/execute-sql.queries.ts` (new) | Lookup/update of persisted `execute_sql` tool-call parts by `query_id` |
| `apps/backend/src/agents/tools/execute-sql.ts` / `story.ts` | Tool description updates + `query_id`-based query editing for the agent |
| `apps/frontend/src/hooks/use-story-filters.ts` (new) | Frontend filter state management, URL sync, debounced filtered-data fetching |
| `apps/frontend/src/components/story-filter-bar.tsx` (new) | Filter UI controls |
| `apps/frontend/src/components/story-embeds.tsx` | Chart/table rendering with baseline/filtered data blending + refresh states |
| `apps/frontend/src/components/side-panel/sql-editor.tsx` | New editable SQL side-panel (run/save-and-run) |
| `apps/frontend/src/components/story-tabbed-content.tsx` + the 3 `routes/_sidebar-layout.stories.*.tsx` files | Wiring filters into each story surface (preview, standalone, shared) |
| `apps/frontend/src/lib/charts.utils.ts` | `alignChartDataToBaselineX` for stable chart axes under filtering |
